scope: Optional authored book cover and presentation cover/closing compositions using native editable scene primitives.
behavior: Strict bounded normalized geometry and palette-role colors; required semantic title; accessible title and image alt; no raw HTML/SVG/URLs in model composition.
Book HTML and slide HTML/PPTX use shared primitive intent; PPTX text and shapes remain native editable objects.
Legacy document output remains byte-identical when composition is absent; optional center image crop affects authored frames only, with legacy attention crop unchanged.
Invalid geometry, semantic roles, contrast, text fit and image framing remain validation errors; invalid finish does not silently remove supplied composition.
Declared image frame and imageName can precede registered asset; finish enforces existing asset gates and later addAsset resolves them.
Theme changes that invalidate authored text contrast reject transactionally and preserve the prior document.
Synthetic architecture fixture uses centered title and a geometric band below, distinct from coastal/music split layouts.

evidence.exports: Each tide/night/grid case has book.pdf, deck.pdf and native deck.pptx. Books: 576x864 CSS pixels and 432x648 PDF points; slides: 1280x720 CSS pixels and 960x540 PDF points.

compatibility.oldDocuments: Documents with no composition preserve legacy output.
compatibility.oldApplication: Old strict DocumentSourceSchema rejects new cover/slide composition fields; old application versions cannot read newly authored composition documents.
compatibility.cutover: Refresh old clients and drain generation plus document writes during coordinated cutover.
compatibility.rollback: Retain new schema plus cover renderer and PPTX support after new composition documents are saved. Do not strip saved geometry or roll back to a wholly old strict reader.

limitations: Synthetic fixtures prove capability and regression behavior, not fresh generated model quality or bespoke design excellence.
Chromium screenshots and measurements run on Windows with available installed fonts. Production Linux may select fallback fonts; universal font fidelity is not established.
PDF page sizes were checked and browser print HTML captured; generated PDF pages were not separately rasterized for this package.
PPTX editability and geometry were checked in XML; actual Microsoft PowerPoint application rendering was not captured.
No production/staging, paid provider, cloud, database, commit or deploy operations were performed.
